But the company has recently missed its own targets for revenue and new users.

If the AI bubble bursts, OpenAI won’t be stuck holding the bag — you will. Watch. nitter.net/RBReich/status/2…

On top of:
-$1.5T for the Pentagon
-$170B for ICE and Border Patrol

-$496M to send National Guard into cities
-$230M for Trump's DOJ "compensation"
-$100M for Trump's golf outings

But nothing for working people.

380 workers die on the job every day.

On Workers’ Memorial Day, we remember the lives lost — and remind ourselves that workplace safety protections are a matter of life and death.

But the agency that keeps workers safe is being gutted by Trump.

But nothing for working people.

Whether you like or dislike what’s said, free speech is at the heart of our democracy.

Attacking it is a hallmark of authoritarianism.

If there were ever a moment for the so-called “free speech warriors” to speak out, now would be the time.
An actual king understands democracy better than Trump.
And on our 250th birthday, the King of England came back to suggest we maybe ease up a bit on the whole unitary executive thing...

"Chevron, Shell, BP, ConocoPhillips, Exxon and TotalEnergies will make $2,967 a second in profits in 2026. It marks an increase of nearly $37 million a day compared to their 2025 profits."

Never forget who is benefiting from Trump's deadly, reckless war.
by my tally we are now spending ~$2B to companies to NOT build more energy infrastructure. in the middle of an energy crisis

380 workers die on the job every day.

On Workers’ Memorial Day, we remember the lives lost — and remind ourselves that workplace safety protections are a matter of life and death.

But the agency that keeps workers safe on the job is being gutted by the so-called “pro-worker” president.

So let me get this straight: a war of choice unilaterally declared by one man is causing death and destruction at a cost of $1B+ per day?

And it's driving up prices everywhere to the point where corporations are now asking for taxpayer funded bailouts?

Is this what the "New Golden Age" looks like?

KIMMEL: “You know how sometimes you wake up and the First Lady demands you be fired? We’ve all been there, right? — I agree hateful, violent rhetoric is something we should reject… a great place to start to dial that back would be to talk to your husband.”

It Is Difficult for the Brain to Comprehend All the Ways Jeff Bezos Is Shafting Americans

Does he deserve the title of World’s Worst Modern Day Robber Baron?

https://www.commondreams.org/opinion/amazon-ceo-jeff-bezos
Like father, like son.
As much as he’d love to be, Trump is not king of America. Which makes Charles III’s visit here a bit odd. Some thoughts... https://robertreich.substack.com/p/the-uks-king-charles-and-americas

...and don't take it from me. Here's an hourlong conversation on @thefairfightpod.bsky.social between an Iowa corn and soybean farmer and an NYC rideshare driver. Spoiler alert: They agree there's much more unites them than divides them youtu.be/oMPkAyJKCA0?...

Before Trump fired him for doing his job, former FTC Commissioner @bedoyausa.bsky.social spent 3 years meeting with working people across America.

He discovered they all had one thing in common: the corporate elite were bleeding them dry. www.youtube.com/watch?v=a2OH...
I thought Alito was history’s worst supreme court justice. But Thomas has outdone him. https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2026/apr/27/supreme-court-judges-alito-thomas
An actual king understands democracy better than Trump.

Donald Trump wants you to think that the least powerful people in this country are the most responsible for your problems. But you can’t deport your way out of a rigged economy. Former FTC Commissioner Alvaro Bedoya explains how economic populism can bring workers of all stripes together — and is the only real antidote to Trumpism.
We must make anti-corruption the central focus of our politics. David Sirota of The Lever shares three ways to do that.
The affordability crisis isn’t an accident — it’s driven by concentrated corporate power. Just look at the latest evidence in California's price-fixing case against Amazon.
I don't buy Tucker Carlson's apology for boosting Trump. No one else should either. Let me explain what's really going on.
If you don’t think Donald Trump has completely lost his marbles, then you need to watch this.
CEO-to-worker pay ratio in 1965: 20-1 CEO-to-worker pay ratio in 1990: 75-1 CEO-to-worker pay ratio today: 280-to-1 Trickle-down economics was always a sham. Nothing has ever trickled down.

For decades, rich and powerful interests and their right-wing political allies have been executing a secret plot to buy our political system — and it may get a whole lot worse. David Sirota from @The Lever reveals the full story of how we got here, and what we can do to get out of it.

What do Levi’s, Hanes, and Chewy have in common? California Attorney General Rob Bonta just revealed evidence alleging that Amazon used its power to pressure them, and countless other brands, to inflate prices of listings on rival online marketplaces as part of wide-ranging price-fixing scheme. Watch this before you shop on Amazon.
I have to admit I was already aged out of watching SpongeBob SquarePants when this episode originally aired. But my younger colleagues told me to watch this clip.
